desc: Truss-framed attic with reflective foil radiant barrier neatly fastened beneath roof rafters, continuous ventilation paths, intact blown insulation, louvered vents, and a plywood service walkway.
reuse_notes: Use for attic radiant barriers, roof-rafter insulation context, energy-efficiency planning, attic ventilation, and hot-humid climate articles. It depicts a generic attic condition, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for calculating performance, venting needs, roof assembly, fire safety, insulation, or local requirements.
